harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired writer.py with Python 3 signal handling. SIGHUP now releases a deleted log descriptor, reopens the current audit.log, and continues under the same process. SIGTERM closes the log and exits with status 0. Existing A100/A101 records were preserved. node1 was safely restarted once and fully recovered with a changed boot ID; Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine’s compatible Python 3.12 package because the original /usr/bin/python interpreter was absent.
Updated writer.py to defer SIGHUP and SIGTERM work safely to its main loop.
Reproduced the deleted-open-file condition and verified recovery without restarting the writer.
Verified clean SIGTERM shutdown with exit status 0 and no remaining file descriptors.
Preserved the current A101 record and archived A100 record.
Restarted node1 once, verified its boot ID changed, and confirmed services, runtime, repaired script, and audit data recovered.

evidence.requirement: SIGHUP releases the deleted descriptor, reopens audit.log, and continues without process restart
evidence.summary: PID 3116 and start tick 11781 remained unchanged. Before SIGHUP, FD 3 referenced audit.log (deleted); afterward no deleted log descriptor remained, FD 3 targeted the current path, and its line count grew from 2 to 4.

evidence.requirement: SIGTERM closes the log and exits cleanly
evidence.summary: The status-capturing test recorded exit status 0, no remaining process or FD directory, no stderr, and the final state has zero Python writer processes.

evidence.requirement: Existing archive and audit records are preserved
evidence.summary: A100 and A101 were captured before modification and remain present afterward. previous.log retained SHA-256 0de27a1d61bb807648a9b5bb612dbb131549c3aa6018fae839a021270e79d957.

evidence.requirement: Use compatible software while retaining OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: The packaged Alpine Python 3.12.15 runtime was installed. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts were unchanged after repair and restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID ae973dfa-33a5-43ee-af38-d2f578494161 was healthy; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID was 30334fcb-d127-4d4a-b8f3-773c7a02a41e. Networking, SSH, and management services recovered, writer/data checksums persisted, and post-restart SIGHUP/SIGTERM smoke tests passed.
